name: OpenHiggsfield AI Studio
postCreateCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.9 --activate && pnpm install && pnpm build
postStartCommand: (for i in $(seq 1 30); do if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ] && [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ]; then GH_TOKEN="$GITHUB_TOKEN" gh codespace ports visibility 3000:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" >/tmp/port-public.log 2>&1 && break; fi; sleep 2; done) & nohup pnpm start -p 3000 > /tmp/openhiggsfield.log 2>&1 &
